name: python-regex-engine
title: Regular Expression Engine
blurb: A pattern compiled to a Thompson NFA and simulated as a set of states, so matching costs one pass and never backtracks; the same pattern is determinised and both machines are proved equal by enumeration.
default_description: A small regular expression engine whose cost is one pass, with both machines printed and compared.

verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
